test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people Mia, Alexander, Sophia, Liam, Olivia, and Ethan are sitting on a circular table facing towards the centre. Mia sits to the immediate right of Ethan. Sophia sits opposite to Ethan. Alexander and Olivia sit opposite to each other and Alexander is not a neighbour of Liam. Who sits to the immediate right of Olivia?
solution:
Given: Six people Mia, Alexander, Sophia, Liam, Olivia, and Ethan.

1) Mia sits to the immediate right of Ethan.

2) Sophia sits opposite to Ethan.

3) Alexander and Olivia sit opposite to each other and Alexander is not a neighbour of Liam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc960131a4e445009f9867e162145b2d03b31aeb520b4d75fa02cce3cff1ce96.png] 

So, **Ethan **sits to the immediate right of Olivia.

Hence, the correct answer is "Ethan".
